title: RDA DSL (suse-library block)
description: JSON Schema for the suse-library: block of an RDA project's chart/values.yaml. Validates the unified DSL describing workloads, services, ingress, and per-stage overrides.

name.description: Project / release name. Used as the default for workload labels and Helm release naming.

domain.description: Base DNS domain used to derive ingress hostnames when not explicitly set per-workload.

ingress.description: Ingress-controller-wide defaults (className, annotations, TLS) applied to every workload's ingress unless overridden.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of imagePullSecret references injected on every workload's PodSpec.

services.description: Backing services this chart depends on. Each entry is a binding (e.g. database, cache, auth) backed by a chart type (postgresql, redis, dex, ...).

workloads.description: Application workloads (deployments, jobs, cronjobs, daemonsets) this chart renders.

overrides.description: Per-stage deep-merge overlays. Keys are stage names (dev, staging, prod, ...); values are partial DSL maps merged into the top-level on `rda render --stage <stage>`.

type.description: Service type as catalogued in dsl-mappings.yaml (e.g. postgresql, redis, dex, minio).

binding.description: Logical binding name within the chart (e.g. database, auth, cache). Must be unique within services[].

provisioning.description: How the service is provisioned: 'deploy' renders the AppCo sub-chart inline; 'connect' expects an external instance configured via .connection; 'operator' delegates to a CRD-backed operator.

connection.description: External connection parameters used in provisioning=connect mode. Shape depends on the service type; common fields are host/port/database/username/password.

passthrough.description: Developer-set chart values forwarded verbatim into the AppCo sub-chart's values. Use to expose chart knobs the DSL doesn't model.

enabled.description: Toggle for the binding. Defaults to true; set to false to keep the entry in values.yaml without rendering it.

name.description: Workload name. Must be unique within workloads[].

shape.description: Workload shape. 'web' renders a Deployment + Service (and ingress when hosts are set); 'worker' is a long-running Deployment with no Service; 'cron' is a CronJob; 'daemon' is a DaemonSet.

port.description: Container port the workload listens on. Required when ingress.hosts is set.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the main container, in addition to the binding-derived ones.

ingress.description: Ingress configuration for this workload. Inherits suse-library.ingress defaults.

replicas.description: Replica count for Deployment-shaped workloads. Ignored for cron/daemon shapes.

schedule.description: Cron schedule (5- or 6-field). Required when shape=cron.
